description: Get the current workspace's info: name, slug, its organization's plan and the plan limits pooled across the organization - workspaces, member seats, pages, storage, upload size, Content API requests and transfer per month, orders per month, and whether single sign-on is included. Only pages and orders can be unlimited (null). Read-only and takes no input. Returns { id, name, slug, plan, limits }; limits holds maxPages, maxMembers, maxWorkspaces, maxStorageMb, maxUploadMb, maxApiRequestsMonth, maxBandwidthGbMonth, maxOrdersMonth and canUseSso. These are limits only, not current usage. For languages and enabled features, use get_site_config.
name: get_workspace_info
title: Get workspace info
